messages.subject: Calderwater framework - need your help
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi Sarah,

We've been shortlisted by Calderwater Utilities for a five-year framework to supply pump sets and spares across their wastewater estate. They want to move to a master supply agreement rather than PO-by-PO. Estimated spend is around £4.2m a year. Could Whitfield Carter take this on? I'd like the same approach as the Stratton deal last year.

Gavin

messages.subject: RE: Calderwater framework - need your help
messages.plaintextBody:
Gavin,

Delighted to help - and yes, this is squarely the kind of framework we did for Stratton. I've attached our engagement letter; Elena Marchetti will run the day to day with me supervising. Once you send the heads of terms you've been discussing with Calderwater we'll mark them up and get straight into the master agreement.

Our estimate to take this from heads of terms to signature is £32k-£40k plus VAT.

Best,

Sarah Whitfield
